name: Context Shunt
description: Blocks oversized full reads before they run and answers questions about large sources with a configurable reader model, returning a bounded citation-verified envelope. Adds a zero-model exact inspector under a cumulative disclosure ceiling and a read-only session accounting view. Read-only: registers no writer tool. Every disclosure is capped per page and charged against cumulative per-source and per-session budgets, so a large payload cannot be reassembled; a source small enough to fit those budgets can still be returned in full by the inspector.

cache_dir.description: Private cache root: SQLite authorization metadata plus content-addressed payload files. Must be outside every workspace root.

spill_dir.description: Deprecated alias for cache_dir, kept so a 1.0 configuration keeps working.

model.description: Reader model. Configurable from 1.1; the envelope's provenance block states what was requested and how strongly the attribution can be believed, so a different model can never be passed off as the default.

provider.description: Optional provider to pin. Empty lets the host route.

attribution_policy.description: What to do when attribution cannot be proven. allow_unverified publishes the truthful unverified label; require_match refuses to answer instead. A contradiction is refused either way.

automatic_extract.description: Compatibility setting for the core exact-extraction tier. OpenClaw selects labelled legacy compaction on exhausted availability; unsafe compaction retains a bounded failure.

fallback_max_bytes.description: Compatibility budget for the core exact-prefix tier; OpenClaw legacy compaction uses its own 16000-character ceiling and the existing envelope byte cap.

fallback_chain.description: Availability-only fallback targets. Never a remedy for a poor-quality answer: every attempt keeps its own reported provenance and usage, and reaching one is recorded as fallback_used.

enabled.description: Deterministic exact extraction. Zero model calls, 16 KiB per page, and every page charged against a cumulative per-source and per-session disclosure ceiling.
Read-only session accounting. Cannot reset a counter, change retention, reach another session or reveal content.
Capture eligible read-only text/JSON via the official OpenClaw 2026.9.3 middleware before model delivery. Disable Tokenjuice and other result reducers atomically when enabling.

host_ordering_verified_locally.description: Deprecated compatibility field; ignored by OpenClaw. Official middleware contract evidence gates capture.

read_only_tools.description: Exact additional tool IDs whose producer contract is read-only. Defaults cover read, web_fetch, web_search. Unknown/mutating/control tools are not covered.

suma_post_tool.description: Deprecated alias for tool_result_capture, accepted so an existing config file keeps working unchanged. Setting both to disagreeing values is refused rather than guessed.

limits.description: Deployment caps. Values may only be narrower than the contract defaults; a widened cap is refused at load time.
